themes_detail.label: Park rule violations surge
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violations spiked to 11 complaints THIS WEEK, up 300% from the 2.8-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.39), suggesting a sudden deterioration in park conditions or enforcement gaps in Parkchester/Soundview parks.
evidence: 11 park rule violation complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8-complaint weekly baseline (300% spike, z-score 3.39)
First major spike in this category in 90-day period
reporting_angles: What specific park rule violations are residents reporting (drug activity, fighting, loitering)? Interview Parks Dept and community.
Which parks are affected—is this a single park (e.g., Soundview Park) or district-wide deterioration?

themes_detail.label: Mobile food vendors spike
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints jumped to 3 THIS WEEK, up 380% from the 0.6-complaint weekly average (z-score: 3.41), indicating either increased vendor presence or resident frustration with unregulated street vending.
evidence: 3 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6-complaint weekly baseline (380% spike, z-score 3.41)
Statistically significant spike with high z-score (3.41)
New pattern—minimal complaints in prior 8 weeks
reporting_angles: Are vendors operating without permits, or are residents complaining about food quality/hygiene?
Interview Department of Health and Mental Hygiene and local businesses about unlicensed vending.

themes_detail.label: Encampment presence escalates
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints spiked 1100% three weeks ago (3 complaints vs. 0.2-complaint baseline, z-score: 4.16), aligned with a 400% spike in homeless person assistance requests last week (5 complaints vs. 1.0 baseline), suggesting an emerging homelessness crisis in Parkchester/Soundview.
evidence: 3 encampment complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2-complaint weekly baseline (1100% spike, z-score 4.16—highest on record)
5 homeless person assistance complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.0-complaint weekly baseline (400% spike, z-score 3.58)
Community Board has repeatedly requested 'expand street outreach' and 'upgrade homeless facilities' funding—unmet need signals
reporting_angles: Where are encampments located (parks, subway, residential blocks)? Interview homeless individuals and service providers.
Why has street outreach capacity not expanded despite repeated CB budget requests? Interview DHS and elected officials.
Connect to April 30 Gothamist stabbing—is area becoming less safe, or is homelessness clustering?

themes_detail.label: Elevator failures in buildings
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 3 THREE WEEKS AGO, up 300% from the 0.8-complaint weekly average (z-score: 3.4), and persist amid 396 active building permits (43 new buildings, 295 alterations), suggesting aging infrastructure or unmet maintenance needs in aging residential stock.
evidence: 3 elevator complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.8-complaint weekly baseline (300% spike, z-score 3.4)
Community Board has requested 'improve accessibility of transit infrastructure by providing elevators' funding—signals persistent gap
396 building alteration permits filed, but only 43 new buildings—suggests aging stock maintenance burden
reporting_angles: Which buildings have non-functional elevators? Interview residents, especially elderly and disabled residents.
Are landlords failing to maintain elevators, or is this a housing stock age issue in Parkchester/Soundview?

themes_detail.label: Residential noise mysteriously plummets
themes_detail.summary: Residential noise complaints dropped 43% THIS WEEK (118 complaints vs. 206.5-complaint baseline, z-score: -4.84), a significant inverse anomaly worth investigating—either neighborhood stabilization, reporting fatigue, or sensor/data anomaly.
evidence: 118 residential noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 206.5-complaint weekly baseline (43% decrease, z-score -4.84)
Largest volume complaint category (3098 over 90 days), but rare downward spike
No corresponding increase in other complaint types—not clearly explained by displacement
reporting_angles: Is 311 data collection affected by a system outage or reporting lag?
Did a major noise source (construction, bar closure, event) stop operating?
